stem.en: Two stalls sell handmade greeting cards. Stall X sells 100 cards at ₹10 each, and each card costs ₹8 to make. Stall Y sells 40 cards at ₹25 each, and each card costs ₹10 to make. Which statement is true?

text.en: Stall Y made ₹400 more profit, though both collected ₹1,000.
Both did equally well, because both stalls collected ₹1,000.
Stall X did better, because it sold more than twice as many cards.
Stall X did better, because each of its cards cost less to make.

explanation.en: Both stalls collected ₹1,000. Stall X spent 100 × ₹8 = ₹800, so its profit was ₹200. Stall Y spent 40 × ₹10 = ₹400, so its profit was ₹600. Stall Y made ₹400 more.

hints.en: Work out the money collected and the costs for each stall before you compare them.
